email.subject: Quick fix for Salt Flat Auto Care's site
email.body:
Hi Aisha,

I looked at Salt Flat Auto Care's website. Two things are likely costing you calls: there's no click-to-call number, so mobile visitors searching for auto care in Harbor Falls can't tap to call you, they have to copy the number manually (many just leave). The page title also doesn't mention Harbor Falls or auto repair, which hurts how you show up in local search.

I fix issues like this for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change and why. Worth a quick look?

Alex
Northlight Web
